bindingObservations.note: These are local JSON binding observations, not a rerun of source-page closure or any native validation gate.

independentAdjudication.mechanicalConditions: Coupled disturbances, elastic versus surface-wave restoring mechanisms, finite pattern propagation, transverse displacement and parallel longitudinal displacement are consistent with the elementary propagating-wave model.
independentAdjudication.waterMotion: Slots7-8 explicitly assume small waves, negligible current and slow drift, and permit horizontal particle motion. Pattern travel is distinguished from material transport; neither locale makes an absolute no-drift or vertical-only claim.
independentAdjudication.tensionComparison: Slot10 uses the same rope under otherwise comparable conditions. This is an adequate bounded elementary comparison, not a universal statement that tension alone fixes speed in unrelated media. The frozen tension/linear-density reasoning is used to interpret the comparison; no equation is invented or required in the candidate.
independentAdjudication.crestTracking: Slot9 identifies the same crest as the tracked pattern. This does not identify material speed or assert universal equality of crest speed and energy/group speed.
independentAdjudication.energyAndAttenuation: Slot20 is read in its explicit disturbance-passing and wave-travel context. Energy transfer does not require the medium to travel as a whole; this is weaker than an absolute prohibition of material drift. Kinetic and elastic potential energy, and conversion of mechanical energy into internal energy, are retained. The amplitude statement describes this dissipative mechanism, not destruction of total energy or the only possible cause of attenuation.
independentAdjudication.standingWaveBoundary: The source freeze considered standing-wave net-flux limits independently. The candidate's introductory traveling-disturbance context supplies the model scope; absence of a separate standing-wave caveat is not adjudicated as a concrete defect or added as a new gate.
independentAdjudication.electromagneticVacuum: Slot21 distinguishes a material medium from electromagnetic fields in vacuum, retaining radio and light and finite physical propagation. Vacuum is not asserted to exclude fields.
independentAdjudication.bilingualEquivalence: The same examples, model qualifications, direction definitions, energy conversion, figure numbers and pulse-versus-train distinctions are present in ZH and EN. No minimum bilingual defect was found.
independentAdjudication.historicalAndNeutralContext: The raw N37 prose contains no named inventor, country, date, national statistic or priority attribution to sanitize. Ordinary examples and pedagogical context are retained; no unrelated historical claims are added.

Medium-particle coupling supports transmission of a disturbance; the introductory explanation is not treated as a claim that every particle oscillation necessarily propagates identically in every direction.
Propagation of oscillation/disturbance is retained as the wave concept. No requirement of strict periodicity is imposed on the later isolated spring pulse.
Bulk elastic interaction is distinguished from gravity/surface-tension restoring effects at a water surface. The text does not infer ordinary transverse shear waves in bulk air.

Approximately regular crest spacing is scoped to a nearly regular train. The matchbox example explicitly assumes small waves, negligible current/drift and permits horizontal oscillatory water motion; no strict vertical-only model is imposed on real water.

Traveling disturbance/shape is distinguished from the same body of water traveling with the pattern. The previous no-current/no-drift approximation is explicitly carried forward, rather than denying real flows.
Finite propagation and the example of tracking the same crest are retained. The example defines that crest's pattern speed, not a universal particle or energy speed.

The tension comparison is bounded to the same rope under otherwise comparable conditions. Fixed-end reflection, near-equilibrium segment motion and displacement perpendicular to propagation are retained without guessing unseen reflection phase or diagram geometry.
